Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.eloquent.casts

Interface AttributeHasher

public interface AttributeHasher
Hashes the text of a hashed cast attribute and recognizes already hashed text; the model supplies it.

Diwan does no hashing: the algorithm, its cost and the salt belong to the implementation, and so does checking a password against a stored hash. Use a password hash such as bcrypt or argon2 from your own library. hash(java.lang.String) turns the text to store into the text the column holds; isHashed(java.lang.String) tells the cast whether a value being set is already a hash, so it is not hashed twice. The column must be a text type wide enough for your hash format.

Implementation Requirements:
Implementations must be safe to share across threads. A wrong isHashed(java.lang.String) can hash a hash a second time or store a plain value unhashed. An exception thrown from any method reaches the caller of the model method as the cause of an InvalidCastException (same instance). An implementation should not throw InvalidCastException; the model rethrows that type as it is.

    • isCurrent

      default boolean isCurrent(String hashed)
      Reports whether an already hashed value uses the current algorithm and cost settings.

      Called only for a value that isHashed(java.lang.String) accepted. When it returns false the write fails and nothing is stored. Override it to refuse hashes below your minimum cost: the default keeps any hash a caller supplies, weak ones included.

      Parameters:
      hashed - the hash being set, never null
      Returns:
      true if the hash may be stored as given
      Throws:
      RuntimeException - if the hash cannot be inspected; the model wraps it in an InvalidCastException with this exception as cause
      Implementation Requirements:
      The default returns true.
